channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: AMD reported third-quarter revenue of $13.4 billion, up 45%, with data center revenue up 97% to a record $8.5 billion, or 64% of the total; it started volume shipments of MI455X and said Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and Oracle brought their first Helios racks online. It guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, plus or minus 3%, a 27% sequential rise at the midpoint. The same night, US voters moved the other constraint: Gina Hinojosa unseated Texas governor Greg Abbott on a pledge of an immediate data center moratorium, and pause advocates Amy Acton and Keisha Lance Bottoms won Ohio and Georgia. Today's live prints are unchanged, so the tape shows 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69, and Crusoe's 1 December rates are still scheduled, not live.

item.title: Compute brief - 4 November 2026
item.description: AMD reported third-quarter revenue of $13.4 billion, up 45%, with data center revenue up 97% to a record $8.5 billion, or 64% of the total; it started volume shipments of MI455X and said Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and Oracle brought their first Helios racks online. It guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, plus or minus 3%, a 27% sequential rise at the midpoint. The same night, US voters moved the other constraint: Gina Hinojosa unseated Texas governor Greg Abbott on a pledge of an immediate data center moratorium, and pause advocates Amy Acton and Keisha Lance Bottoms won Ohio and Georgia. Today's live prints are unchanged, so the tape shows 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69, and Crusoe's 1 December rates are still scheduled, not live. Countries: United States: Governors who pledged data center pauses won Texas, Ohio and Georgia; Texas has about 6.5 GW under development (Wire, 3 Nov, corroborated). Malaysia: Google commits an additional $15 billion for 2027 and 2028 across Selangor and Negeri Sembilan, plus more than 1 GW of clean energy with TNB (Wire, 4 Nov). China: Oracle reportedly scraps a $7 billion, 100,000-chip Southeast Asia lease to Tencent after US pressure (Wire, 4 Nov, single-source FT). Portugal: Government finalising rules requiring renewable power and no competition for fresh water; more than 2.6 GW under development (Wire, 4 Nov). South Korea: Science ministry plans a 2027 large-scale reference pairing AMD CPUs and GPUs with Korean NPUs (Wire, 4 Nov). Australia: Goodman and Digital Realty offer A$715 million for 9.9% of NextDC after its M3 Melbourne grid delay (Wire, 4 Nov).
